title: Continuity of a Gaussian Fourier integral
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $a\in\mathbb R$, and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb C$ be integrable with respect to standard Gaussian measure. The function sending $x\in\mathbb R^n$ to $\int_{\mathbb R^n} e^{i a\langle t,x\rangle} f(t)\,d\gamma(t)$ is continuous.
hypotheses_covered: $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb C$ is integrable with respect to standard Gaussian measure
